destination.title: Flux constraints, quantization and sources
destination.question: Which flux and localized-source configurations satisfy the relevant Bianchi identities, quantization rules, tadpoles and global consistency conditions?
destination.summary: Separates effective constraints, cohomological formulations, source-modified identities and construction-dependent charge lattices.

systems: Type II flux compactifications and orientifolds
regimes: Source-free and source-inclusive analyses treated separately
assumptions: A truncated cohomological identity need not exhaust higher-dimensional constraints
conventions: Integer coefficients are not a universal generalized-flux quantization prescription
includes: Questions about extensions beyond toroidal examples
excludes: Automatic existence of a fully localized solution from integrated constraints

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: What is the R-R charge lattice when NS-NS coefficients are logarithms of integral monodromies rather than integer inherited-form coefficients?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Do nongeometric fluxes possess source solitons analogous to NS5 and KK5 objects, and can their contributions relax the corresponding flux constraints? The paper poses this as an unresolved extension.

sources.title: On Missing Bianchi Identities in Cohomology Formulation

evidence.text: Which quadratic NS-NS flux constraints are missed by the known cohomology formulation of type IIA Bianchi identities, and can their structure be expressed using topological data for applications beyond toroidal orientifolds?

sources.title: On brane gaugino condensates in 10d

evidence.text: Determine how compact geometry changes cancellation of a localized codimension-two source when bulk flux periods are quantized.

sources.title: Cobordism Classes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which spin backgrounds remain allowed after including the heterotic B-field constraint? The distinction depends on Yang–Mills flux and fivebrane sources.

sources.title: Rigid nongeometric orientifolds and the swampland

evidence.text: Does harmonic nilpotency constrain this type IIA orientifold? The parity projection removes the even-form flux sector, and rigidity trivializes the remaining antisymmetric relation.

sources.title: Rigid nongeometric orientifolds and the swampland

evidence.text: Do the additional toroidal constraints persist on generic rigid Calabi–Yau orientifolds and obstruct simultaneous H,Q flux there?

sources.title: Tadpole versus anomaly cancellation in D = 4, D = 6 compact IIB orientifolds

evidence.text: When are RR tadpole cancellation and gauge anomaly cancellation equivalent in compact D=4,6 Type IIB orientifolds, and do tadpole conditions uniquely determine the gauge group?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Transport reference R-R polyforms, differentiate, and match operator coefficients. Restrict outputs to one lower/base index per flux; unrestricted generalized fluxes and R flux are not supplied.

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Uplift the source system, retain its assumed geometrical Bianchi identity, and change the reduction circle. Map both curvature and signed sources to identify the resulting ten-dimensional RR identity and compare consistency conditions.

sources.title: On Missing Bianchi Identities in Cohomology Formulation

evidence.text: Use nilpotency of D=d+H∧-ω⊳+Q⊲-R•. Its flux pieces change form degree by +3,+1,-1,-3. The first formulation is associated with nilpotency on generic forms, while the second imposes it on harmonic forms; Jacobi identities of the flux algebra provide another established route to the first constraints.

sources.title: On brane gaugino condensates in 10d

evidence.text: Track measure, inverse-metric and spinor-derivative powers through reduction and field substitution. Distinguish the Kähler-independent form from the volume-normalized form before comparing the gaugino interaction coefficients.

sources.title: Cobordism Classes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Construct a quotient filling, place the asymptotic compactification at infinity, and transport it by T-duality. Compatible wrapping yields a filling for the product circle class.

sources.title: Rigid nongeometric orientifolds and the swampland

evidence.text: Translate standard equations into cohomology variables through the explicit invariant-flux dictionary. Compare the resulting polynomial constraints with direct harmonic nilpotency.

sources.title: Taxonomy of scalar potential with <math display="inline"><mi>U</mi></math>-dual fluxes

evidence.text: How can the large four-dimensional scalar potential induced by U-dual-completed type IIB fluxes be reorganized to expose its flux-bilinear structure, constraints and possible higher-dimensional origins?

sources.title: An Orientifold of type IIB theory on K3

evidence.text: Can an orientifold of Type-IIB on K3 realize six-dimensional N=1 supersymmetry with multiple tensor multiplets, consistent open-string matter, canceled tadpoles, and canceled gravitational and gauge anomalies?

sources.title: N=1 effective potential from dual type-IIA D6/O6 orientifolds with general fluxes

evidence.text: How do general fluxes and D6/O6 sources determine the four-dimensional N=1 potential directly from ten-dimensional type IIA, and which consistency conditions and supersymmetric moduli-stabilizing vacua extend beyond truncated N=4 gaugings?

sources.title: Metastable vacua from torsion and machine learning

evidence.text: What classical ten-dimensional ingredients generate the proposed four-dimensional vacuum potential? The starting source set contains three-form fluxes, D3-branes and O3− planes, while the torsional five-form and wrapped D5 ingredients are introduced subsequently.

sources.title: Orientifold Calabi-Yau threefolds with divisor involutions and string landscape

evidence.text: Which nontrivial holomorphic divisor-exchange Z2 involutions yield consistent Type IIB orientifolds with odd (1,1) cohomology, and what fixed O-planes, free actions, parity splittings, and naive tadpole-compatible configurations occur?

sources.title: Lectures on Nongeometric Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Which nongeometric flux effective theories possess complete string descriptions, and how far do toroidal constructions extend? The outstanding questions concern R-flux, worldsheet consistency, non-toroidal compactifications and the relation to generalized-structure reductions.

sources.title: The Type IIA Flux Potential, 4-forms and Freed-Witten anomalies

evidence.text: How can the classical type IIA flux F-term potential, including D6-brane moduli and localised sources, be organised through four-forms, axion polynomials and microscopic anomaly cancellation?

sources.title: KK-monopoles and G-structures in M-theory/type IIA reductions

evidence.text: Can metric fluxes and moduli in M-theory/massive IIA STU models be represented by intrinsic torsion, permitting higher-dimensional uplifts even when the Jacobi constraints required for ordinary twisted-torus reductions are relaxed?

sources.title: Nongeometric flux compactifications

evidence.text: Construct a T-duality-complete flux superpotential and flux constraints for a simple type II toroidal orientifold, including nongeometric Q- and R-fluxes, and clarify which structures admit local or global geometric interpretations.

sources.title: Superstrings with intrinsic torsion

evidence.text: Which intrinsic-torsion conditions are necessary and sufficient for static NS-NS string backgrounds to preserve supersymmetry, what additional Bianchi conditions produce solutions of the equations of motion, and how can these conditions generate explicit flux geometries?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Which generalized NS-NS flux configurations admit consistent four-dimensional IIA orientifold descriptions and useful moduli potentials?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Which effective generalized-flux configurations have ten-dimensional origins, and can all their constraints be formulated using orientifold cohomology?

sources.title: Zp charged branes in flux compactifications

evidence.text: How do background fluxes modify the conserved charges and allowed decay processes of wrapped branes giving four-dimensional particles, strings and domain walls, and how are these changes represented by discrete gauge symmetries and identifications of flux vacua?

sources.title: Classification of discrete modular symmetries in Type IIB flux vacua

evidence.text: Which modular subgroups survive three-form fluxes on toroidal orientifolds, and how do flux quantization, tadpole cancellation and magnetized D-branes constrain their realization?

sources.title: Testing Swampland Conjectures with Machine Learning

evidence.text: How do constrained RR, NS-NS and non-geometric integer fluxes determine extrema and scalar spectra in an isotropic Type IIB compactification?

sources.title: Flux Landscape with enhanced symmetry not on SL(2, ℤ) elliptic points

evidence.text: How do geometric dualities, enhanced symmetries and a bounded flux D3 charge organize physically distinct SUSY Minkowski F-term solutions on two one-complex-structure toroidal orientifolds?

sources.title: D = 4, N=1, type IIB orientifolds

evidence.text: Which toroidal type IIB orientifolds yield consistent D=4, N=1 vacua, how restrictive are their tadpole conditions, and what do alternative projections imply for spectra, candidate heterotic duals and effective interactions?

sources.title: Towards Minkowski Vacua in Type II String Compactifications

evidence.text: Can non-geometric type II orientifolds admit supersymmetric Minkowski vacua with every retained modulus stabilized, tadpoles satisfied, and parametrically large fields at weak string coupling?

sources.title: Non-perturbative and Flux superpotentials for Type I strings on the Z(3) orbifold

evidence.text: Which ED5, ED1 and closed-string flux effects generate superpotentials in the Type I Z3 orientifold with Wilson lines, how does anomalous U(1) invariance constrain them, and could their combination stabilize moduli?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Which combinations of H, metric, Q, and R flux admit consistent four-dimensional N=1 IIA orientifold descriptions, how do they generate D-terms and stabilize moduli, and which admit ten-dimensional constructions with correct flux quantization?

sources.title: NS-branes, source corrected Bianchi identities, and more on backgrounds with non-geometric fluxes

evidence.text: How do NS-branes source ten-dimensional NSNS Bianchi identities, and when can β-supergravity describe backgrounds with non-geometric fluxes geometrically? The second question includes whether the identified backgrounds yield physics beyond geometric T-duality orbits.

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Which flux and localized-source combinations define consistent compactifications and effective theories when geometrical flux changes the internal topology? The paper studies this question classically, principally for type-IIA orientifolds with four-dimensional supersymmetry.

sources.title: Flux moduli stabilisation, Supergravity algebras and no-go theorems

evidence.text: Which flux-induced supergravity algebras are compatible with the isotropic T⁶/(Z₂×Z₂) orientifolds, and which resulting effective models can evade necessary no-go conditions for nonsupersymmetric Minkowski or de Sitter vacua with stabilized moduli?

sources.title: New Examples of Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Which geometric type IIA and massive IIA Minkowski flux backgrounds arise by T-dualizing toroidal type IIB orientifolds, and how do their fluxes, localized-source tadpoles and equations of motion evade the compactification no-go obstruction?

sources.title: Fixing moduli in exact type IIA flux vacua

evidence.text: Do the supersymmetric type IIA flux vacua obtained from four-dimensional effective theory admit ten-dimensional descriptions, how does flux/O6 backreaction modify Calabi–Yau geometry, and how does ten-dimensional flux quantization fix moduli?

sources.title: Fluxes, moduli fixing and MSSM-like vacua in a simple IIA orientifold

evidence.text: Which moduli can RR, NS and metric fluxes stabilize in a simple IIA orientifold, and can the resulting backgrounds support consistent intersecting-D6 configurations with MSSM-like spectra?

sources.title: Rigid nongeometric orientifolds and the swampland

evidence.text: Can nongeometric fluxes support de-Sitter critical points in a rigid type II orientifold after all NS-NS consistency constraints are imposed? The paper tests an explicit toroidal sector with no complex-structure moduli.

sources.title: GUTs in Type IIB Orientifold Compactifications

evidence.text: Can compact Type IIB orientifolds realize SU(5) GUT sectors with massless hypercharge, suitable matter and Yukawa couplings while satisfying global charge cancellation, flux quantization and supersymmetry constraints?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization in Non-Geometric Backgrounds

evidence.text: Can intrinsically non-geometric type IIB orientifolds without Kähler moduli stabilize the remaining moduli using quantized R-R and NS-NS fluxes alone, satisfy tadpole cancellation, and yield supersymmetric Minkowski or AdS vacua?
